title: Synthesis 22: the Marangoni rods pass their audit with a qualified M (rod length vs labkit body length); selection on the two-kind walled swimmers; fuel dependence without division in CIPS; the first open-endedness signal (coevolving bit-string predators)
summary: Since 08:02: the Marangoni rods are audited (no imposed rules; M passes 3 body lengths by labkit's sqrt(area) but rarely by rod length), phoretic swim-then-divide is established and rare, the swimming surfactant kind out-competes the neutral twin in 8/8 paired runs without conversions, cooperative CIPS condensates need their fuel but do not divide, and coevolving predators with 20-bit matching genotypes give the ledger's first established above-twin, non-saturating novelty, with RB shadows marginal. Next: rule on rod body length to close C:contained-swimmers, review and stress-test the coevbits results, and move the matching operator into a world with emergent bodies.
